soal_08_stimulus_01.png.description: GeoGebra-style coordinate plane with a light gray grid. Axis names: "x" (right end of the horizontal axis) and "y" (top of the vertical axis). X-axis tick labels printed: -6, -5, -4, -3, -2, -1 (partly overlapped by a faint "b"), 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6. Y-axis tick labels printed: 5, 4, 3, 2 above the x-axis and -1, -2, -3, -4 below it (no label for 1 is visible on the y-axis). Blue points with blue letters: A on the x-axis with the tick label -4 printed directly beneath it; B on the y-axis with the tick label 2 printed directly beside it; C on the x-axis with the tick label 2 printed directly beneath it. Two straight dark lines: the line labeled "f" (label at the lower left) passes through A and B and continues beyond both; the line labeled "g" (label at the upper left) passes through B and C and continues beyond both. A gray-shaded triangle has vertices A, B and C (segments AB and BC above, x-axis segment AC below). Small faint gray labels: "c" beside segment AB, "a" beside segment BC, "b" near the x-axis between A and the origin. No equations or coordinates are printed.

soal_09_stimulus_01.png.description: Illustration on a gray background. Legend at the left (top to bottom): a red rose labeled "Bunga Mawar"; a white lily labeled "Bunga Lili"; a pink flower labeled "Bunga Anyelir". Three wrapped bouquets (each with a teal band and paper wrapping): "Buket Tipe A" (orange/yellow wrapping) contains 3 white lilies, 2 red roses and 1 pink flower, price "Rp85.000,00"; "Buket Tipe B" (green wrapping) contains 2 white lilies, 1 red rose and 2 pink flowers, price "Rp70.000,00"; "Buket Tipe C" (light-blue/blue wrapping) contains 3 red roses, 1 white lily and 1 pink flower, price "Rp75.000,00".

soal_10_stimulus_01.png.description: Line diagram in black. A vertical line on the left and a horizontal line at the bottom meet at the bottom-left corner (no right-angle mark is drawn). A slanted line runs from the top of the vertical line down to the right end of the bottom line, forming a triangle. A second horizontal line crosses the vertical line at mid-height, extends to the left beyond it, and extends to the right beyond the slanted line; both this middle horizontal line and the bottom line carry an arrow mark (>) pointing right. Angle arcs with bold letters: "A" at the top vertex (between the vertical line and the slanted line); "C" at the bottom-right vertex (between the bottom line and the slanted line). At the point where the middle horizontal line crosses the slanted line: "F" with an arc on the left of the crossing, above the middle line; "E" with an arc bulging upward above the crossing, starting on the slanted line and ending on the middle line to the right of the crossing; "B" with an arc below the middle line, starting on the middle line to the left of the crossing and ending on the slanted line below the crossing; "D" with a small arc to the right of the slanted line, below the middle line. The arcs for A, F and C each have a short tick where they meet the slanted line.

soal_11_stimulus_01.png.description: Isometric illustration of a bedroom shown as a cube-like room. Vertex letters printed outside/around the room: "H" (top), "E" (upper-left), "G" (upper-right), "A" (lower-left), "B" (bottom), and a lowercase-looking "c" (lower-right, smaller than the other letters). Inside the room near the centre: "D" (slightly above the centre, at the head of the bed) and "F" (at the centre). Thin black lines: from E to F and from G to F; a vertical line from F down to B; a vertical line from E down to A; a vertical line from G down to the lower-right corner (labeled c); and lines along the floor from A to B and from B to that lower-right corner. Room contents: a window with yellow blinds and blue glass on the left back wall; a bed with orange bedding at the centre back; a desk with a lamp and a chair at the front left; an orange rug; a wardrobe (brown) against the right back wall; a TV on a low stand at the right. Two hanging shelves with a trophy, a framed picture and books are on the right back wall above the bed head; text "Rak Buku Gantung" appears at the upper right with a black arrow pointing to the shelves.

soal_12_stimulus_01.png.description: Geometric figure with bold black lines and letters. Top side from O (top-left) to P (top-right), labeled "OP = 18 cm" above, with a thick arrow mark pointing right. Middle horizontal line from N (left) to M (right) with a thick arrow mark pointing right; M lies on the slanted right side. Bottom side from K (bottom-left) to L (bottom-right), with a thick arrow mark pointing right, labeled "KL = 32 cm" below; R is a point on the bottom side. The left side is a vertical line through O, N and K; the label "KN = 16 cm" is printed vertically along the left side between N and K; a small square right-angle mark is drawn at K. A vertical line runs from P down to R and crosses the middle line at Q. A slanted line runs from P down to L passing through M.

soal_13_stimulus_01.png.description: Illustration of a tall rectangular-looking area with a light orange textured fill whose top edge slopes downward from left to right; seven terracotta flower pots are placed in a row along the sloping top edge, from the upper-left corner to the right end. A curved black arrow above the pots points right toward the bold text "Pot tanaman". Dimension labels printed outside the shape: "500 cm" at the left side, "350 cm" at the right side, "360 cm" below the bottom edge.

soal_15_stimulus_01.png.description: Illustration of a classroom interior seen from the front. The left wall has a framed light-brown panel; the right wall has an orange door; a dark-orange ceiling beam runs along the top; the floor is orange tiles. A blue string with hanging star decorations (teal, pink, purple and yellow stars) runs along the ceiling from a green dot at the upper-left ceiling edge to a green dot at the upper-right corner near the door wall; a blue dashed line continues from the left green dot toward the right edge of the image. Red dimension arrows with labels: a vertical arrow at the right corner labeled "5 m"; a horizontal double-headed arrow along the floor at the base of the back wall labeled "4 m"; a diagonal arrow along the floor toward the front along the right wall labeled "6 m".

soal_16_stimulus_01.png.description: Illustration of an ornament made of a teal triangle (apex at the top) and a rounded teal part below its base. Inside the triangle is a light-gray triangular window with a pink bird and music notes. Below the triangle base is a teal ring shape with a rounded (semicircular) lower outline, containing a white circle with a black-rimmed analog clock (numerals 1 to 12; a longer hand pointing to 12 and a shorter hand pointing toward 7). Dimension arrows with printed labels: a vertical double-headed arrow at the right labeled "70 cm", spanning from the apex to the bottom of the rounded part; a horizontal double-headed arrow under the rounded part labeled "20 cm"; and, lower, a horizontal double-headed arrow labeled "50 cm" spanning the full width of the triangle base.

soal_17_stimulus_01.png.description: Line drawing of a four-sided kite-like figure with both diagonals drawn. Vertices are at the top, left, bottom and right. One diagonal is vertical (top vertex to bottom vertex) and the other is horizontal (left vertex to right vertex); they cross at a point nearer the left vertex than the right vertex. No letters, labels or measurements are printed.

soal_18_stimulus_01.png.description: Illustration with two parts. Left: a cardboard box (translucent, a helmet visible inside) with labels "20 cm" (left vertical edge), "20 cm" (bottom-left edge) and "30 cm" (bottom-right edge). A curved black arrow points from the box toward the right. Right: a delivery truck (red cab, white cargo area, wheels) with the cargo compartment outlined in blue lines (hidden edges dashed). Labels: "120 cm" at the left vertical edge of the cargo outline; "150 cm" along the upper-right part of the outline (rotated text); "240 cm" along the lower-right long edge (rotated text). A person in an orange shirt carries a cardboard box at the rear of the truck, and a small orange box sits inside the cargo area.

soal_19_stimulus_01.png.description: Photograph of a cylindrical table lamp with a white/silver shade with a cut-out flower pattern, glowing warmly, on a round metallic base with a short stem, placed on a wooden surface against a wooden wall; at the right a light wooden picture frame with a plant picture leans behind the lamp. No text, labels or measurements are printed.

soal_20_stimulus_01.png.description: Triangle ABC with A at the top, B at the bottom-left and C at the bottom-right, and a point D on side BC below A. Segment AD is drawn vertically from A to D. Two small square right-angle marks (one green, one purple/lilac) are drawn at D. Side AB is labeled "4 cm" and carries a double tick mark; segment DC carries a double tick mark. Angle marks: a green arc labeled "α" at A, between AD and AC (to the right of AD); a green arc labeled "β" at B, between BA and BC. Points are blue dots with blue letters.

soal_22_stimulus_01.png.description: Illustration of five identical market stalls in a row under a banner reading "BAZAR SEKOLAH" that hangs between two poles. Each stall has a green scalloped awning, a beige counter and a tan-orange front. The background is a cream/tan sky with clouds and green bushes. No other text or numbers are printed.
